reason: judged the change against the issue: every requirement is met

answers: lens-security-code finding 1: done — bounds check `[[ "$_fsp_resolved" == "${_fsp_artifacts_dir}"/* ]] || _fsp_resolved=""` added in `_runner_from_stage_preflight`; any path escaping artifact_dir is cleared and the `[[ ! -s ]]` guard exits 1.

lens-security-code finding 2: done — bounds check `[[ "$_dc_resolved" == "${state_dir}/artifacts"/* ]] || _dc_resolved=""` added in the cycle-skip guard in runner.sh; out-of-bounds path treated as absent → stale-artifact exit-1.
lens-security-code finding 3: done — bounds check `[[ "$_du_resolved" == "${state_dir}/artifacts"/* ]] || _du_resolved=""` added in the dispatch-unit stage-skip guard; same fail-closed behavior.
lens-security-code finding 4: done — `_fsp_cycle_safe="${_fsp_from_stage//[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/_}"` strips all non-identifier characters (not only hyphens), closing the indirect expansion risk.

lens-performance-code finding 1: wrong — `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` writes `current_iter=N` BEFORE dispatch so an interruption mid-iteration records the interrupted iteration number, not the last completed one; without it, resume would start one iteration too early (the correctness requirement DSITER-1). The two writes serve different purposes at different points and merging them reintroduces the resume-starts-at-wrong-iteration bug.

lens-performance-code finding 2: not mine — eliminating `dirname` subprocesses in `_artifact_persist_put_back` is a micro-optimization on a non-blocking cold path; no acceptance requirement governs subshell count there.

lens-performance-code finding 3: not mine — consolidating jq calls per skipped member in `_cycle_iter_dispatch` is a micro-optimization; no acceptance requirement governs jq call count on the resume skip path.

lens-red-team-code finding 1: done — cap added: `(( _CYCLE_MAX_ITER > 0 && _start_iter > _CYCLE_MAX_ITER )) && _start_iter=$_CYCLE_MAX_ITER` ensures a corrupt persisted iter above max resumes at max rather than zero-iterating into the unconverged path.

lens-red-team-code finding 2: not mine — verifying skipped cycle members' artifacts inside `_cycle_iter_dispatch` requires `_find_plugin_for_stage` from dispatch.sh, which is not sourced by cycle-orchestrator.sh; adding it is a structural dependency change outside this issue's scope; the outer dispatch-unit check in runner.sh (cycle:* arm) already catches fully-complete cycles before the orchestrator runs.

lens-correctness-code finding 1: not mine — distinguishing "completed in iteration N" vs "iteration N-1" for the DSCMBR-1 skip guard requires per-iteration member status in the state schema, a data-model change outside this issue's scope; no acceptance test covers the interrupted-at-iter-start-before-first-dispatch edge case in this issue.

lens-correctness-code finding 2: done — both read and write paths now use `jq --arg id "$cycle_id"` (unsanitised original value), so a cycle ID with dots or special characters keys consistently in both directions.

lens-scope-code finding 1: wrong — the traversal guards in `_artifact_persist_put_back` are required by CLAUDE.md ("Sanitize file paths to prevent directory traversal"); the docstring phrase "identical semantics" means the same files at the same paths from the caller's perspective, which holds because git-archive-extracted content never has leading slashes or `..` components.

lens-scope-code finding 2: wrong — the guards cannot fire for git-archive-extracted content; in practice the behavior is identical to the original `_hydrate_put_back`. RQHYDR-1 is satisfied: both hydrate and runner's resume path share the one implementation.

lens-sre-code finding 1: not mine — adding a machine-readable event for the jq blob-update failure in `_cycle_iter_dispatch` requires registering a new event in `config/event-schema.json`; that is outside this issue's scope. Warn to stderr is emitted; fail-closed is provided by the dispatch-loop stale-artifact exit-1 path enforced by the passing test suite.

lens-sre-code finding 2: not mine — adding a machine-readable event for `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` failure requires a schema addition outside this issue's scope. Warn to stderr is emitted; the DSITER-1 write-side test verifies the write succeeds in normal operation.

lens-sre-code finding 3: not mine — adding a machine-readable event for `_artifact_persist_put_back` failure inside `_runner_resume_rehydrate` requires a schema addition outside this scope. The fail-closed guarantee is provided by the dispatch-loop stale-artifact exit-1 path (DSRHYD-2, enforced by passing tests).
